prompt: Create exactly nine minimalist hand-drawn doodle pictograms in a regular 3x3 grid. Pure white smooth rounded outline strokes of consistent width on genuinely transparent background. Items in reading order, left to right, top to bottom: Chorizo; Wiener Würstchen; Bockwurst; Mortadella; Cabanossi; Teewurst; Pastrami; Entenbrust; Frikadellen.
